title: Guarded portal facility under Forest Service cover

tellings.quote: There is a portal in the United States.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFO claims, says on a podcast that there is a portal in the United States, which the story places at Bradshaw Ranch in Arizona. As the story goes, it is a guarded site hidden behind the cover of the US Forest Service, the agency that runs national forests. If true, the government would be protecting a doorway to somewhere else.
